title.zh: 离子注入：剂量不等于活性浓度
title.en: Ion implantation: dose is not active concentration

subtitle.zh: 从离子束、结深到退火激活
subtitle.en: From ion beams and junction depth to anneal activation

body.zh: 工艺原理；用可控离子束改变指定区域的掺杂状态
body.en: Process principle Use a controlled ion beam to change doping in a specified region

body.zh: 剂量与束流；剂量决定导入多少离子，但不等于活性浓度
body.en: Dose and beam current Dose determines how many ions are introduced; it is not active concentration

body.zh: 能量与深度；能量与离子、材料共同决定投影射程和展宽
body.en: Energy and depth Energy, ion species and material jointly determine projected range and straggle

body.zh: 角度与通道；晶向、倾角和旋转角共同决定深尾风险
body.en: Angle and channeling Crystal orientation, tilt and twist jointly determine deep-tail risk

body.zh: 掩膜与阻挡；开口决定注入区域，厚度决定能否真正挡住
body.en: Masking and stopping The opening defines the implanted region; thickness determines stopping ability

body.zh: 均匀性与充电；扫描、束斑和电荷中和决定片内一致性与介质安全
body.en: Uniformity and charging Scanning, beam spot and charge neutralization determine within-wafer consistency and dielectric safety

body.zh: 损伤与激活；注入负责导入原子，退火负责修复与电学激活
body.en: Damage and activation Implantation introduces atoms; annealing repairs damage and provides electrical activation

body.zh: 量测闭环；总浓度、活性载流子和器件结果必须分层验证；SIMS总浓度；片阻/Hall电性；器件结果
body.en: Metrology loop Total concentration, active carriers and device results require separate validation SIMS total concentration Sheet resistance / Hall electrical measurements Device results
